World Information: Gosha Village is the headquarters of the Taimanin created by assembling the shinobi and clans, who were originally scattered across Japan. Forming out of the fusion of smaller villages it now has a population of 10000 people. A few years before the Fuuma Revolt, during the Taimanin Unification began the construction of the unified village for the many Taimanin Clans, which before this had their own villages. This should be in all continues around the year 2065. Gosha Village would later war against Fuuma Village, in year 2068. Taimanin (対魔忍), also known as Anti-Demon Ninjas, are human ninjas which are able to use Taima Particles to fight criminal demons or humans. The term can address individuals or Gosha Taimanin, which are a combined force of different ninja clans which recently united and are supported by the Japanese government. As an organization, they are not public knowledge and are ordered to perform investigations, infiltration, espionage, hostage rescues and elimination of demons or dangerous groups of interest for justice. The Gosha Taimanin are watched over by Section Three, which also gives out missions of the state. They are viewed as a more offensive option against demons, unlike the more defensive Onmyoji.
